001: Do you feel like meeting up on Saturday to grab a drink?
I'd love to! What time works best for you?
Around seven, if that sounds good to you.
Perfect. Shall we meet at the usual bar?
Yes, I really like that place.
Great, noted. See you Saturday then.
002: Can we move up our meeting on Thursday?
Sure, what day would work better for you?
Okay, does ten o'clock work for you?
Yes, perfect. Thank you so much for being flexible.
No problem, just let me know if anything comes up.
003: Have you already made plans with Marta to see the exhibition?
Not yet, do you think she'll like it?
I'm sure she will, she loves modern art.
Then I'll text her right now to suggest it.
Good idea, that way we can lock it in as soon as possible.
Okay, I'll let you know what she says.
004: I'm so sorry I'm late, have you been waiting long?
Don't worry about it, I just got here myself.
Good to hear, I was afraid I'd missed something important.
Relax, you haven't missed anything. Should we order something?
Yes, I'm really hungry, to be honest.
Well, let's take a look at the menu then.
005: Does meeting on Monday to prepare the trip work for you?
I can't on Monday, I have class until late.
Great, let's meet then at four.
Perfect, I'll bring the tickets so we can compare.
006: Could you come with me to look for a gift tomorrow?
Sure, I love going shopping with you.
Does eleven o'clock sound good to you?
Yes, but can we meet at the square?
Okay, we'll see each other there, no problem.
007: Do you still want to go to the concert on Friday?
Of course I do, I'm really looking forward to it.
Well, I was thinking we could have dinner beforehand.
Great idea! Do you know any place nearby?
There's a really good Italian place two blocks away.
Well, I'll book a table for eight, does that sound good to you?
008: Do you mind if I invite Diego to our get-together?
Not at all, I really like Diego.
Great, that makes four of us in total.
Are we still meeting at the same place?
Yes, there's plenty of room there.
Then I'll text him now to let him know.
009: Do you have plans for Sunday afternoon?
I don't have anything planned, why do you ask?
I was thinking of going to the park, do you feel like coming?
That sounds like a great idea, it's a nice day.
Well, I'll bring something to eat to share.
Awesome! I'll take care of the drinks.
010: Can we change the time of tomorrow's dinner?
Sure, what time did you want to meet?
Would a bit later work for you, around nine?
Yes, perfect, that way I can get here from work without rushing.
Then we'll confirm it for nine.
